_note: The Rotwood, level 13: a forest dying of something that spreads. See docs/zones.md.

exposure.name: spores
exposure.warn: There's mould in your throat. You need clean air: a burned clearing.
exposure.hurt: The spores are growing in your lungs.
exposure.relief: The burned ground is clean. You cough the spores out.

rw_outpost.name: The Warden Outpost
rw_outpost.description: A palisade at the edge of the blight, behind a firebreak. Wardens in masks.

rw_edge.name: The Blight Edge
rw_edge.description: Where the healthy trees stop. Past here every trunk is furred with grey mould.

rw_groves.name: The Rotting Groves
rw_groves.description: Trees soft as bread, sagging. The air is thick with drifting spores.

rw_burnt.name: The Burned Clearing
rw_burnt.description: A clearing the Wardens burned. Black, bare, and clean.

rw_bloom.name: Bloom Hollow
rw_bloom.description: A hollow full of pale fungal blooms the size of tents, pulsing.

features.bloom: A bloom-heart: the thing that spreads the spores. It would burn.

rw_elkrun.name: The Elk Run
rw_elkrun.description: A trail trampled flat by something big and rotten.

rw_weeping.name: The Weeping Glade
rw_weeping.description: Trees weeping grey slime around a pulsing heart of fungus.

features.heart: A second bloom-heart, bigger, slick with slime.

rw_mould.name: The Mould Wall
rw_mould.description: A wall of fungus, with a way through like a throat.

rw_heart.name: The Fungal Heart
rw_heart.description: The middle of the blight: a mound of fungus that breathes. Through the spore-haze beyond, a green and living jungle that shouldn't be there.

features.core: The Mind's core, pulsing. Fire would hurt it.
features.jungle: A green so bright it hurts, through a ripple in the air.

firepots.name: Pim's fire-pots
firepots.description: Clay pots of Pim's oil, with fuses.

maelis.name: Warden-Captain Maelis
maelis.label: Warden-Captain
maelis.description: a grim woman in a mask, her eyes red-rimmed
maelis.details: A grim woman in a mask, her eyes red-rimmed.

topics.work: Ask me about the wardens, or the mind.

wardens.text: Six of my Wardens went in without masks. They're out there still, walking. Put them down. Please.

mind.text: There's something at the heart of it. It thinks. Pim calls it the Mycelial Mind. Its spore-burst can't be stopped, only survived. Kill it and the blight dies.

lure.sense: {Where}, the smell of a firebreak, and voices behind masks.
lure.rumour: The Warden-Captain at the outpost needs help against the blight.

pim.name: Pim
pim.label: Herbalist
pim.description: a round little man in three masks
pim.details: A round little man in three masks.

topics.work: Ask me about the mask, or the bloom.

mask.text: Five breaths in there and the spores take root. A mask, my own design. Ask me for the mask.

bloom.text: The bloom-hearts spread it. Burn three: the one in Bloom Hollow, the heart in the Weeping Glade, and the core at the Fungal Heart. Take my fire-pots.

lure.sense: {Where}, the smell of herbs boiling over a fire.
lure.rumour: Pim the herbalist is after something that grows in the blight.

pims_tincture.name: Pim's Tincture
pims_tincture.perfect_hit: {actor} drinks Pim's tincture, and it takes.
pims_tincture.description: Bitter, and it clears the lungs. Works best in still air.

mycelial_lash.name: Mycelial Lash
mycelial_lash.description: A tendril of the Mind, dried and braided. It likes the damp.

spore_mask.name: Spore Mask
spore_mask.description: Pim's mask: herbs in a cloth beak. Keeps off the spores.

captains_mantle.name: Warden-Captain's Mantle
captains_mantle.description: Maelis's own mantle, green and grey. +2 Resilience.

mask.goal: Ask Pim for it: DISCUSS MASK WITH PIM.

effects.text: Pim fits the mask on you. "WEAR MASK. And breathe through your nose."

pots.goal: Take Pim's fire-pots: DISCUSS FIREPOTS WITH PIM.

one.goal: Burn the bloom-heart in Bloom Hollow: USE FIREPOTS ON BLOOM.

effects.text: The bloom shrieks as it burns.

two.goal: Burn the heart in the Weeping Glade: USE FIREPOTS ON HEART.

effects.text: Slime boils. The glade stops weeping.

three.goal: Burn the core at the Fungal Heart: USE FIREPOTS ON CORE.

effects.text: The core blackens. The whole Rotwood shudders.

back.goal: Tell Pim: DISCUSS BLOOM WITH PIM.
Tell Maelis: DISCUSS WARDENS WITH MAELIS.

reputation.note: You gave the lost Wardens rest.

kill.goal: Kill the Mycelial Mind, at the Fungal Heart.

back.goal: Tell Maelis: DISCUSS MIND WITH MAELIS.
